text.tspan: Ward — authority and data flow
Installation and review do not imply activation; revocation cannot undo completed effects
1 Install / import
Record host-owned isolation identity
Copy immutable revision; inspect requested access
Editable manifests cannot switch to trusted loading
2 Explicit review / approve
Select exact revision and capability leaves
Reject authority roots, ancestors and aliases
Sign record; do not start worker
3 Admit / start
Verify live record; reserve epoch and unit
Authenticate controller; mount pinned resources
Worker sees a minimized grant projection
Present only through host-owned output views
4 Worker request / bounded effect
Authenticate UID + cgroup; recheck live authority
Match selected argv / HTTP / setting scope
Snapshot DATA into sealed file descriptors
Host CLI / service acts with its stated authority
5 Revoke / stop / recover
Persist and sync pending denial → attempt unit stop → sign and publish disabled record
Signing failure does not restore permission: denial remains; report failure and recover explicitly
Future requests fail. Already completed filesystem, network and service effects are not undone.
Presentation direction: worker Wayland → private compositor → GPU buffers → Qt host.
Input direction: authorized host gesture / summon → private compositor → worker.
Release gates: native packaging, failed-start lifecycle and installed / physical-display acceptance.
